reportMarkdown:
## Post-Opacity Wide DataTable CPU Profile Finished

**Index:** 39
**Checkpoint:** `e673845ea346d851995adb185c02103a4180359f`
**Attempt Count:** 1

### Report

**Passed Status:** true. Headed WebGPU CPU profiles at both DPRs preserved exact final offsets, renderer/layout telemetry, and zero errors. Relative to experiment 36, `Color::from_encoded` self time fell 74.98%/79.18%, `Color::opacity` fell 59.66%/81.85%, total gpux color-family self time fell 56.50%/61.64%, and text `Window::paint_layer` self time fell 64.58%/45.19% at DPR 1/2.

The identity-opacity optimization therefore removed the dominant default-paint color reconstruction cost. Remaining leading local families include style refinement, pooled Taffy requests, bounds insertion, monochrome sprite sorting, and global element-ID path allocation; residual color callers should be traced separately before another color change.

### Scope Lock

Measurement only. No source, dependency, shader, renderer, layout, or public API change was made.

### Decision

Accept the profile as evidence and use it to route the next atomic hypothesis. Do not broaden the accepted identity-opacity implementation inside this experiment.
decisionMarkdown: Accept the profile as evidence that identity-opacity elision removed the dominant default-paint color cost. Trace residual color callers and rank other local families in separate experiments.
